description: This file defines the DotNetSerializableCodec class, which implements serialization and deserialization logic for types that implement the ISerializable pattern within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes methods for writing and reading objects, handling exceptions, and managing serialization callbacks.

classes.name: DotNetSerializableCodec
classes.description: A serializer for types implementing ISerializable, providing methods for writing and reading such objects within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field of an object, handling value types and reference types appropriately.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from the reader, handling references, exceptions, and object reconstruction.

methods.name: ReadFallbackException
methods.description: Handles deserialization of unknown exception types into a fallback exception class.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads an object from the reader, reconstructing it using serialization callbacks and constructors.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes an object, including its type information and fields, invoking appropriate callbacks.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported by this serializer, including exception types and types with serialization constructors.
